about: The recurring cast: one avatar and one voice per character, the same in every video. A story names a member by its lowercase id as a speaker; story.json casting says who plays the narrator and any role, and defines extras for one job. Read by pipeline/cast.py. Change a member only on purpose: every later video changes with it.

phone_line.about: heard down a phone line (the-door's dispatcher)

wrong.about: something imitating a person: slower, flatter, pitched down, a little echo (the-door's thing)

close.about: the same thing heard right at the ear: slower and lower again, a double echo (the-door's thing_close)
